title: Xl map fixes and general improvements
changes: Fixed lighthouse placement on XL map.
Slight UI simplification for desktop and mobile view.
Modified trade modal to allow more than 1 trade per click. Example: you can now trade 8 oak for 2 cereals in one click (assuming the 4:1 rate applies)
UI shows how many buildings you have left for each kind

title: New XL Map
changes: New XL Map has been added to the game. It has 37 hexes instead of 19, recomended for at least 4 players.
Fixed support button UI positioning during games, both on mobile and desktop view.

title: Initial Release
description: First production release of Klatana, a free to play and free to mantain, opensource, realtime, multiplayer turn-based strategy board game.
